channel.title: CMMC Weekly Briefing | Vigilant Cybersecurity
channel.description: A weekly, plain-English roundup of CMMC rule changes, Cyber AB news and enforcement actions for Alaska defense contractors.

item.title: A quiet week while the CMMC task force report stays under wraps
item.description: No new CMMC rules, C3PAO news or DOJ settlements surfaced September 21–25. The Reform Task Force's recommendations still aren't public, and self-assessment obligations remain in force.
